column1: # Installed skill roots whose content is authored in the reviewed suite upstream, and which may
# therefore keep the programmed-updater no-review carve-out.
# This file is the AUTHORIZATION source, and it is deliberately separate from the skills themselves.
# A skill's own `metadata.github-repo` is written by whoever authors that skill upstream and copied
# verbatim into the installed root, so reading it to decide whether its change needs review lets an
# upstream grant itself the carve-out by editing one line of its own frontmatter. There is no other
# install record — no lockfile, no manifest — so the trusted list has to live here, in a reviewed
# file, and a change to it goes through the normal review path like any other.
# Absent from this list means semantic review, so a newly installed skill and a third-party one are
# treated the same until someone deliberately adds a row.
# Format: <repo>\t<installed skill root>\t<upstream that owns its content>
# Lines beginning with `#` and blank lines are ignored.
